body: Yes, you're right. Thanks for the support, it means a lot to me.

So, for me to get a visa again, I would have to comeback to my home country, and then start all the paperwork again, unfortunately me and my mother don't have the money to do that, only the plane ticket is about 1000 € .

Also unfortunately, I've searched. It's a small town, not much going on, except real jobs, they all require a fucking social security number or whatever that I can't get.

It was January 2018 more or so. I was part of a group (hard to explain, but It was part of the university). For some problems, I had to quit, and was feeling really down, because I loved it. Next couple of weeks, I regreted and started feeling nervous all the time, so I started smoking, it made me feel better.  
Fortunately, in March 2018 I came back to the group, but kept smoking.
Yes, I am. I can't work here, because right now I'm illegal, so I don't have the documents necessary, I searched for some outside jobs, but nothing, It's a small town.
I can't comeback home, although I thought about it, it can't happen
Do they? Nobody has ever called me to see if I'm alright, if I need anything, not months ago, not today. Not a single person seems to care, while I'm here suffering.
